lines.text: // Glyphs rasterise on first use at the exact pixel size into RGBA8 atlas pages: white, with coverage in alpha.
// Colour emoji share the pages, resampled to a Font Size square.
// When every page is full, the least recently used one is cleared; one used this frame is never cleared.
// The longest Twemoji sequence, a couple kissing with skin tones, has 9 codepoints once U+FE0F is left out.
// From the pen position on the baseline to the bitmap's top-left corner.
// The RGBA8 image for a codepoint sequence, U+FE0F left out, in memory from malloc; NULL when there is none.
typedef unsigned char *(*VdEmojiLoader)(const VdEmojiSequence *sequence, int *width, int *height);
// Codepoints a font lacks come from the fallback; ones neither has draw the requested font's missing-glyph box.
VdGlyph glyph_cache_get(const VdGlyphFont *font, int size, uint32_t codepoint);
// The emoji for the longest prefix of sequence that has an image, as a Font Size square on the font's line; false
// when no prefix has one. A ZWJ sequence without its own image so draws as its first emoji.
bool glyph_cache_get_emoji(const VdGlyphFont *font, int size, const VdEmojiSequence *sequence, VdGlyph *glyph);
// Decodes the codepoint at text, which must not be at its terminator, and sets length to the bytes it used.
// Malformed UTF-8 decodes one byte at a time as VD_UTF8_REPLACEMENT.
// The bytes of the emoji cluster at text, with its codepoints in sequence, or 0 when text does not start one. A
// cluster starts at a codepoint from U+1F000 up or one followed by U+FE0F or a keycap mark, and takes skin tones,
// tags, a second regional indicator and ZWJ-joined codepoints.
// Emoji sit at the font's ascent, so the key holds the font.
// A glyph that is not color marks a sequence with no image.
// Shelf packing: glyphs fill a row left to right, and a row is as tall as its tallest glyph.
// The page that now holds a width x height rect at (x, y), or -1 when no page can take it this frame.

lines.text: // Area-averages the image into a size x size square, weighting colour by alpha so edges do not darken.
static bool rasterise_emoji(const VdGlyphFont *font, int size, const unsigned char *image, int image_width,
unsigned long r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0;
for (int sy = y0; sy < y1; sy++) {
for (int sx = x0; sx < x1; sx++) {
unsigned char *pixel = pixels + ((size_t)(y + row) * VD_GLYPH_ATLAS_PAGE_SIZE + (size_t)(x + col)) * 4;
unsigned long count = (unsigned long)(x1 - x0) * (unsigned long)(y1 - y0);
bool glyph_cache_get_emoji(const VdGlyphFont *font, int size, const VdEmojiSequence *sequence, VdGlyph *glyph)
// It keeps its advance and draws nothing, rather than loading again every frame.
placed = rasterise_emoji(font, size, image, width, height, glyph);
if (first < 0x1f000 && next != VS16 && next != KEYCAP) return 0;
// DejaVuSans-ascii.ttf is assets/fonts/DejaVuSans.ttf subset to U+0020-007E, under the same licence.
static void expect_cluster(const char *text, int bytes, const uint32_t *codepoints, int count, const char *message)
bool same = got == bytes && (bytes == 0 || sequence.length == count);
for (int i = 0; same && bytes > 0 && i < count; i++) {
fprintf(stderr, "glyph_cache_harness: cluster of %d bytes and %d codepoints, want %d and %d\n", got,
expect_cluster("A", 0, NULL, 0, "a letter is not an emoji");
expect_cluster("\xe2\x9d\xa4", 0, NULL, 0, "a text-style symbol without U+FE0F is not an emoji");
expect_cluster("1", 0, NULL, 0, "a digit is not an emoji");
expect_cluster("\xf0\x9f\x8e\xae!", 4, (const uint32_t[]){0x1f3ae}, 1, "a single emoji is one codepoint");
"U+FE0F makes a symbol an emoji and is left out of the sequence");
(const uint32_t[]){0x1f1ed, 0x1f1fa}, 2, "a flag is two regional indicators");
(const uint32_t[]){0x1f468, 0x200d, 0x1f469, 0x200d, 0x1f467}, 5, "a ZWJ sequence is one cluster");
"a trailing ZWJ is not part of the cluster");
// Pretends assets/emoji holds 1f3ae, 2764 and 1f468: 8x8 images, opaque red inside a transparent border.
static unsigned char *fake_emoji_loader(const VdEmojiSequence *sequence, int *width, int *height)
expect(glyph_cache_get_emoji(full, size, &controller, &emoji), "an emoji with an image resolves");
expect(emoji.color && emoji.page == 0, "an emoji is a colour glyph in an atlas page");
"an emoji is a Font Size square");
expect(emoji.offset_y == -(int)roundf(glyph_font_metrics(full, size).ascent), "an emoji sits at the ascent");
expect(pixels != NULL, "an emoji marks its page dirty");
"an emoji keeps its colour in the RGBA page");
expect(corner[3] == 0, "an emoji keeps its transparent border");
expect(same_glyph(emoji, again) && emoji_loads == loads, "a cached emoji does not load again");
expect(large.width == size * 2 && !same_glyph(emoji, large), "another size is another emoji");
"a symbol with U+FE0F resolves to its emoji image");
expect(glyph_cache_get_emoji(full, size, &family, &from_family), "a ZWJ sequence without an image resolves");
"a ZWJ sequence tries itself and each shorter prefix that ends on an emoji");
expect(same_glyph(from_family, from_man), "a ZWJ sequence without an image draws as its first emoji");
expect(!glyph_cache_get_emoji(full, size, &missing, &none), "an emoji without an image does not resolve");
expect(asset != NULL, "Twemoji images ship under assets/emoji, named without U+FE0F");
